properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-toolchain transitive dependency (elliptic/ethereumjs stack under Hardhat/Truffle). No first-party import of hash.js found in the repo's own .ts/.sol code — recorded as shipped library surface; the build ships these algorithms whether or not the application calls them.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This repo is an Ethereum DeFi SDK, so secp256k1 is the curve the whole ethers/truffle/ganache toolchain signs and verifies with. The shipped product additionally verifies secp256k1 ECDSA on-chain at contracts/router/Router.sol:321,369 — reported as a separate finding. Changeable only at the Ethereum protocol level (ecrecover precompile).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-toolchain transitive dep (ssh2 via truffle-dashboard tooling). bcrypt-pbkdf is a bcrypt-based KDF rather than the bcrypt password hash itself, but the bcrypt-family classification is accurate. No first-party call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Three secp256k1 ECDSA private keys hardcoded as `accounts` for the local in-memory Hardhat network (which forks mainnet via RPC). Dev/test-only by design — 0xbe5d6e33… is one of Hardhat's well-known deterministic dev keys, but the two 0x473acc21… literals are custom look-alike keys, and all three are genuine committed key material: any address funded with one of them on a live network is instantly compromised. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ships the weak KDF in the dependency tree whether or not this app calls it — presence is what the inventory records. Changeable here only by pruning tooling deps.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project's core curve: every deployed Router swap authorization and permit signature is secp256k1 ECDSA, and the TS side signs with secp256k1 wallets (ethers v6 uses @noble/curves). Quantum-vulnerable signatures — a deadline risk (forged signatures cannot retroactively compromise past swaps). First-party use sites reported separately.
